name: Live band for a holiday party: Tejas Singh quartet
description: Tejas Singh's quartet plays a holiday party with a dance floor in front of the band. It's a great choice if you want people dancing at a party or reception.
more: The quartet is Tejas on voice and guitar with bass and drums, plus keys or a second guitar. The band watches the dance floor and chooses each next song to keep people dancing, and it can play a downtown Denver ballroom or your own office.
